title: Affiliate Ops Reconciler
one_liner: Upload Shopify/affiliate exports and get a reconciled creator payout ledger with tiered commissions, promo-code overlap handling, suspicious attribution flags, anomalies and payment-ready totals.
buyer: DTC Shopify brands with roughly 20-100 active creators that have outgrown spreadsheets but do not want enterprise affiliate software or a dedicated marketing-ops hire.

pain.description: Monthly reconciliation of creator commissions, custom tiers, promo-code overlaps, attribution exceptions and payouts becomes manual, error-prone and financially risky as affiliate programs grow.

findings: AffluTrack launched in 2026 with multi-touch attribution and commission-fraud detection from $29/month.
Vyral includes fraud detection and automated affiliate rules in a free-to-install plan.
Influencer Affiliate Pro automates commission calculation and exports detailed commission history from $9/month.
Refersion is mature, highly reviewed and already combines attribution, commission management and payouts.
Shopify Collabs itself provides affiliate tracking plus procedures to flag high-risk creators and combat affiliate fraud.
Specialist affiliate-fraud/audit products also exist outside the payout workflow, so independent audit is not an uncontested wedge.
competitive_validation.conclusion: The pain is real, but the proposed product sits in a crowded feature set with low-cost and free incumbents. Building a generic reconciliation or fraud layer now would violate Wealth Engine's capital-allocation discipline.

decision.reason: No sufficiently sharp competitive wedge survived the second gate.
decision.reopen_only_if: A future independent signal reveals a materially different capability, proprietary data advantage, distribution advantage, or recoverable-money mechanism that incumbents do not already provide.

lesson: Pain evidence is not business evidence. Validate competitive substitutability before prototype construction, especially in app ecosystems with cheap incumbents.
